en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a row of old European-style houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The large building on the right has small-paned windows with shutters and notice boards mounted on the exterior wall at street level. There are a few pedestrians walking along a quiet, tree-lined street. The overall look is of a small town or village, likely in Central or Eastern Europe, photographed in the early to mid‑20th century.
